name: The Hearth Cook
notes: DRAFT for C13-5 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Orange Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (the scaling guide puts a Guardian at about 90% of the tier max; hits-to-beat in the 40-80 boss band). Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: hot pot rush
attacks.note: Calls two Spark Sprites and stirs a red circle around the pot.

phases.tell: It raises its big ladle; red circle.
The pot bubbles and sparks hop out.
phases.senseiLine: Little ones first. Then the cook.

phases.tell: A striped lane and double marks.
phases.senseiLine: The rolling pin is coming. DASH.

lines.intro: The ovens are cold. The cook is lonely.
lines.freed: Is it supper time? I would love some company.
lines.senseiAfter: You kept going, one step at a time.

description: The Hearth Cook bonks with its ladle, calls spark helpers, then rolls a giant pin down a striped lane.

bestiary.tip: Ladle, sparks, then the rolling pin.

lore.orange: A big, round cook with a ladle. The shadow made it guard the cold ovens alone. Free it, and its light comes home.
